name: Two Faces (deep-thinking dialogue)
description: Read-the-text films: two painted faces on black, one lit warm and one cold, eyes dart and blink, a slow push, quoted lines in the top third aligned toward the speaker, the last line larger. No voice; an ambient pad. Original art; the structure is learned from three reference films that share one painted pair.
rules: Two faces only; nothing moves but the eyes, the breath and a slow 3-6 % push.
Frames: two-shot to open, close-up of the near face for questions, close-up of the far face for the heavy lines, the tightest push on the last line.
Quoted lines, small, top third; left when the near face speaks, right when the far face speaks; the last line is 1.6x larger.
No cuts faster than 2.5 s; hold time = 0.35 s per word + 1.2 s.
No voice by default; one ambient pad mastered to -14 LUFS, a soft tone when the speaker changes.
native_moves: card grows to fill the frame for one beat, then the face returns
a face punch-in on the keyword

structures: numbered steps with a card each
one claim, three screenshots, a CTA
before and after of one document
endings: the face with the last card pinned above

camera_language: Face crops punch in and out on hard cuts; the card animates in place.
typography: word-pop captions with an accent keyword.
audio_direction: Voice from the clip; music bed 6 dB under, no sound effects.
pitfalls: Do not put captions over the face's mouth.
Do not hide the face for long stretches.
